This page is generated by scanning every published guide for `[SCREENSHOT: …]` placeholders — the convention the install guides established (see `docs/install/macos.md`, `docs/install/windows.md`). It exists so a real screenshot pass has a single checklist instead of scattered TODOs, and so an outstanding placeholder is visible, not silently forgotten. It is **not** a build failure — outstanding screenshots are an expected pre-launch state.
